title: Segmentation fault on exported Linux projects when calling `is_valid_filename()` of LineEdit's empty text
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.2

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - openSUSE Tumbleweed 20260327 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (nvidia) - AMD Ryzen 5 1600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.54 GiB memory

### Issue description

This is one of the most weird bugs I have ever encountered. Basically, if I have a LineEdit node and in code I set the LineEdit's text property in a variable, and on that variable I call `is_valid_filename()`, it crashes with no error messages, besides segmentation fault (core dumped). But, this only happens when the field is **empty**, and only on **exported Linux builds**. I tried Windows, Android and Web and it doesn't seem to happen there.

It also **doesn't happen** if I do `"".is_valid_filename()`, or
```gdscript
var text := ""
print(text.is_valid_filename())
```

It doesn't seem to happen with `is_empty()` either. I haven't tried any other string methods besides these two. Also, when I set the text property to the variable, if I do: `var text := line_edit.text + ""`, it then seems to be working fine. This is very weird behavior overall and I am concerned this issue may happen elsewhere as well, but I haven't encountered it anywhere else as of right now.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new Godot project using Godot 4.6.2 (I haven't tested any other versions, but I am pretty sure it does not happen on 4.5.x and older). Add a LineEdit node as a child of the root node, and on the root node, add this script:
```gdscript
extends Control

@onready var line_edit: LineEdit = $LineEdit


func _ready() -> void:
	var text := line_edit.text
	print(text.is_valid_filename()) # crash
```

If you run it from Godot, it will run just fine. But if you export it as a Linux binary (x86_64, haven't tested other architectures), and then run it, it will crash immediately.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[linux-lineedit-crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26680183/linux-lineedit-crash.zip)
